what_this_is: Ledger §22 v2, the isolated re-run: baseline (main 57e7ce3a) against the candidate, 36 of §20's parameter files, five ABAB rounds each; the primary speedup is the paired ratio of total time (both arms at one unit); the ratio in each process's own unit is beside it. Every process ran through tools/isolated_bench.py; figures use clean pairs only.

host.build: cargo build --release --bin ic --example koblitz_descent_prices, clean tree, rustc above
host.hardware_class: one x86-64 cloud container; no claim for Arm64, GPUs or other hosts
host.pinning: tools/isolated_bench.py run --wait: RAYON_NUM_THREADS=1 on CPU 2; the thread check RAYON_NUM_THREADS=3 on CPUs 1-3; the tool's defaults (settle 2 s, other processes at most 0.10 CPUs, PSI some avg10 at most 5)

rho_control.control: baseline batch rho counts == §20's at k0n41 M1
